usedFor: WooCommerce holds your shoppers and Calendly books time with them. “New Customer Created” can run “Create One-Time Meeting”, so a new buyer can get an onboarding call set up.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer Created” in WooCommerce, then “Create One-Time Meeting” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new customer is the moment a welcome call makes sense, while coupon and product triggers have nothing to do with a person you would meet.

watchOut: “Customer Updated” also reaches this action, so an edited profile could create another meeting. Keep it on “New Customer Created”.
